screen.nscapebeyond.flash_warning.title: WARNING: Flashing Lights
screen.nscapebeyond.flash_warning.body: Nullscape Beyond is a mod that contains flashing lights and rapidly changing visuals that may trigger seizures in people with photosensitive epilepsy. A Photosensitive option is available in the mod's configuration file or inside the mod configuration tab. Player discretion is advised.

config.nscapebeyond.accessibility.photos: Reduces or removes flashing and rapid visual effects.
config.nscapebeyond.visual.accessory_too: Show the mod's styled tooltip for accessories instead of the vanilla one.
config.nscapebeyond.visual.colored_light: Dynamic colored light from blocks, block entities and entities.
config.nscapebeyond.visual.light_strengt: How strongly colored light is applied. 100% is the default.
config.nscapebeyond.visual.emissive_text: Glowing parts of the mod's blocks and entities ignore lighting and shine with a neon look.

message.nscapebeyond.mart.full: Mart can't hold any more water
item.nscapebeyond.charger_boots.desc:
Hold %1$s to charge. Press %1$s mid air to perform a quick drop.
Hold %2$s to create a platform for airborne charging.
Causes knockback against entities on impact.
item.nscapebeyond.diver_helmet.desc:
Tap %1$s to dive. Causes damage against entities on impact. 
Pressing %2$s  does a longer dive. You can jump out of dives.
item.nscapebeyond.wanted_hat.desc:
Tap %1$s to parry. Parrying has a small window. Holding %1$s after a successful parry grants a vertical boost.
 Hold %2$s to activate a cloak, consumes stamina.
item.nscapebeyond.glider_kit.desc: Hold %1$s mid-air to glide. Aim with the camera or directional keys. Hitting an entity while gliding at high speeds does mutual damage. Has a dedicated stamina bar.
item.nscapebeyond.spirit_necklace.desc:
Press %1$s to leave your body behind. Grants enhanced mobility outside your body. Press %1$s again to teleport back. 
Press %2$s to leave a catapulting body, launching you back when pressing %1$s depending on the distance. 
Teleporting grants invincibility frames.
item.nscapebeyond.orb.desc: Slight enhancement for class stamina regeneration. Doubles experience gain.
item.nscapebeyond.shark_tail.desc.charge: Allows using extra jumps when charging. Allows long jumping out of platform charging.
item.nscapebeyond.shark_tail.desc.diver: The longer %1$s or %2$s is pressed the further the dive will be.
item.nscapebeyond.shark_tail.desc.glider: Jumping doesn't cancel gliding and gives a boost. Increases gliding speed slightly.
item.nscapebeyond.shark_tail.desc.charge: Holding only %2$s makes the air platform slowly rise. Does not rise if both %1$s and %2$s are held.
item.nscapebeyond.shark_tail.desc.diver: Pressing %1$s or %2$s mid-dive converts horizontal speed into vertical.
item.nscapebeyond.shark_tail.desc.glider: Holding %2$s while gliding gives you a speed boost and increases gift collection range.
